title: Letter Case Permutation
description:
Given a string s, you can transform every letter individually to be lowercase or uppercase to create another string.
Return a list of all possible strings we could create. Return the output in any order.
 
Example 1:

Input: s = "a1b2"
Output: ["a1b2","a1B2","A1b2","A1B2"]

Example 2:

Input: s = "3z4"
Output: ["3z4","3Z4"]

 
Constraints:

1 <= s.length <= 12
s consists of lowercase English letters, uppercase English letters, and digits.

    def letterCasePermutation(self, s: str) -> List[str]:

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "a1b2")) == sorted(["a1b2", "a1B2", "A1b2", "A1B2"])
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "3z4")) == sorted(["3z4", "3Z4"])
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "12345")) == ["12345"]
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "C")) == sorted(["c", "C"])
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "ab")) == sorted(["ab", "aB", "Ab", "AB"])
    assert sorted(candidate(s = "a1B")) == sorted(["a1b", "a1B", "A1b", "A1B"])
